reviews.author: Pranay
reviews.title: Best and affordable dog shampoo ever
reviews.body:
I first used this shampoo on my dog and felt the diffference in just one wash, the subtle fragrance, the softness and also it controlled my dog's shedding, but as a new dog parent i made a huge mistake i experimented alot be it in food, care, or other things for my dog as i was especting better result for everything, so i switched to other shampoo which was a bit expensive than this one but now i realise that this is the best one and i re ordered it ❤️

Please go for it without a second thought trust me you will use it lifelong

reviews.title: Solid 5 🌟
reviews.body: It's been 5 months since. Thought my review would help a good product reach more customers. Coat shines. Smells great for next 3 to 4 days after bath. Reduced itching. Good froth. Highly recommended. Highly effective. Yes value for money.
